description_en: Queries the information about a catalog in Data Map. Only catalogs of the Data Lake Formation (DLF) and StarRocks metadata crawlers are supported
description_zh: 获取数据地图中给定数据目录的详情信息，当前支持dlf与starrocks类型
name: GetCatalog

parameters.description_en:
The catalog entity ID. Currently supports dlf and starrocks types. You can refer to the results returned by the ListCatalogs operation and the [Concepts related to metadata entities](~~2880092~~). - For the DLF type, the format is `dlf-catalog::catalog_id`. - For the StarRocks type, the format is `starrocks-catalog:(instance_id|encoded_jdbc_url):catalog_name`. >
`catalog_id`: The ID of the DLF catalog.
> `instance_id`: The instance ID, required if the data source is registered in instance mode.
> `encoded_jdbc_url`: The URL-encoded JDBC connection string. Required if the data source is registered in connection string mode.
> `catalog_name`: The name of the StarRocks catalog.
parameters.description_zh:
数据目录实体ID，当前支持dlf与starrocks类型，可参考ListCatalogs接口返回结果，以及[元数据实体相关概念说明](~~2880092~~)。


- 对于dlf类型，格式为 `dlf-catalog::catalog_id`

- 对于starrocks类型，格式为`starrocks-catalog:(instance_id|encoded_jdbc_url):catalog_name`

> 其中  
`catalog_id`: dlf目录id  
`instance_id`: 实例ID，对应数据源以实例模式注册时需要提供  
`encoded_jdbc_url`: JDBC连接串的URLEncode编码,对应数据源以连接串方式注册时需要提供  
`catalog_name`: starrocks目录名称
